earnings.title: www.pplnewsroom.com
highlights: Achieves 2026 third-quarter ongoing earnings per share (EPS) of $0.54 versus $0.48 in 2025.
Highlights $12 billion to $16 billion of potential additional generation investment through 2032, with Kentucky opportunities that could drive PPL’s EPS CAGR to 9%+ from 2026 to 2030.
This compares to projected annual EPS growth of 6% to 8% in its prior plan.
If realized, this investment could raise PPL’s projected compound annual EPS growth to 9%+ from 2026 to 2030.

quotes.text: Our strong third-quarter results reflect continued execution across PPL and keep us on track to meet or exceed the $1.94 per share midpoint of our 2026 ongoing earnings forecast range.
quotes.by: Vincent Sorgi, PPL President and Chief Executive Officer

outlook: Narrows 2026 ongoing earnings forecast range to $1.92 to $1.96 per share; on track to achieve at least the midpoint of $1.94 per share.

Increases long-term annual EPS growth target to 7% to 9% through at least 2030 off of the company’s 2026 ongoing earnings forecast midpoint; expects annual EPS growth in the top half of the targeted range.
Provides 2027 earnings forecast range of $2.06 to $2.14 per share; midpoint of $2.10 per share represents an 8.2% increase over PPL’s projected 2026 ongoing earnings midpoint.

With PPL’s updated business plan, the company increased its annual EPS growth target to 7% to 9% through at least 2030 off of the company’s 2026 ongoing earnings forecast midpoint, with annual growth expected in the top half of the range.
